name: SmolVLM2-2.2B-Instruct
notes: TWO-PART MODEL. Same efficiency thesis as SmolVLM, smaller text tower. (1) Vision: model_type smolvlm_vision, 27 layers, patch 14, image_size 384, use_base_siglip false (a trained-from-scratch vision tower rather than a frozen SigLIP), with pixel_shuffle_factor 3 and the same 64-latent perceiver resampler (resampler_depth 6, resampler_head_dim 96, resampler_n_heads 16, resampler_n_latents 64). VISION TOKENS = FIXED AT 64 PER IMAGE regardless of resolution, inherited from the Idefics3 design. DOMINANCE: TEXT DOMINATES -- 64 vision tokens. (2) LLM: VLlama3 dense decoder. text_config OMITS num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads and hidden_act, so those were read from safetensors tensor shapes in the repo: q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj all [2048,2048] at layers 0 and 23, mlp gate/up [8192,2048], down [2048,8192] -> hidden 2048, intermediate 8192, 24 layers, MHA with 32 heads of head_dim 64 (head_dim 64 is stated in config), lm_head [49280,2048], vocab 49,280, max_position 8,192. ARCHITECTURE = dense. Method note: the [2048,2048] K-projection confirms 32 KV heads x 64 head_dim; the same tensor-shape method was validated against Qwen2.5-VL-7B (k_proj [512,3584] = 4 x 128, exactly matching num_key_value_heads 4, head_dim 128) before being trusted here. KV CACHE: 24 * 32 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 196,608 B/token -- identical to SmolVLM-2.2B, still MHA. params_b 2.247 = HF API safetensors total (2,246,784,880).
